adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the new logic keeps the original scoped lookup `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.find((credential) => credential.id === credentialId)`, but if that fails it now falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` with no `userId`/`teamId` constraint. The returned credential (potentially belonging to another user/team) is then used to instantiate a calendar integration and call `calendar.deleteEvent(uid, evt, externalCalendarId)`. This is a real, diff-grounded authorization/correctness risk if a booking reference contains an unexpected credentialId.
